name: Umkhuhlane wengane
sources: Red Cross War Memorial Children's Hospital

urgent.heading: Bonana nomtholampilo noma esibhedlela ngokushesha uma
urgent.primary_message: Imfiva eminingi yezingane ayiyona ingozi. Kodwa lezi zimpawu zishintsha izinto - ukuya emtholampilo noma esibhedlela.
red_flags: Ingane engaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-3 enomkhuhlane (38°C noma ngaphezulu)
Imfiva engaphezu kuka-40°C enganeni yanoma yimuphi ubudala
IRash engabuli lapho icindezelwa ngaphansi kwengilazi
Intamo eqinile, ikhanda elibuhlungu, noma ukuzwela ukukhanya
Uyozela, kunzima ukuvuka, noma uthule ngendlela engavamile
Ukuhlanza okungapheli noma ukungachami amahora angu-8+

what_is_it.heading: Imfiva ngamazwi alula
what_is_it.lede: Imfiva izinga lokushisa lomzimba elingaphezu kuka-38°C. Akusona isifo - kuyindlela yomzimba yokulwa nezifo. Imfiva eminingi yezingane iwusizo futhi ayiyona ingozi ngokwayo.
paragraphs: Umkhuhlane usiza amasosha omzimba ukuthi asebenze kanzima ngokumelene nama-virus nama-bacteria. Izinga lokushisa ngokwalo akuvamisile ukubangela ukulimala enganeni — ngisho nezinga lokushisa eliphezulu ‘aliwuthosi’ ubuchopho (lokhu kuwukukhathazeka okuvamile kodwa hhayi ukuthi imfiva iyonakalisa kanjani imizimba). Okubalulekile ukuthi ibangelwa yini nokuthi ingane ibukeka kanjani.

Ingane enomuzwa ojwayelekile ongu-39°C ingase ingakhathazeki kakhulu kunengane eno-38°C ene-floppy, enqaba ukondla, noma engavamile nganoma iyiphi indlela. Themba ukuthi ingane ibukeka kanjani ngaphezu kwe-thermometer. Uma ungabaza, zihlole.

items.headline: Ikakhulukazi KULUNGILE
items.body: Imfiva eminingi yezingane ibangelwa yigciwane, ihlala izinsuku ezingu-2-3, futhi ixazulula ngaphandle kokwelashwa. Umkhuhlane ngokwawo awuvamile ukuba yinkinga.

items.headline: Ngaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-3
items.body: Izingane ezingaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-3 ezinomkhuhlane zidinga ukuhlolwa okuphuthumayo kwezempilo. Amasosha abo omzimba awavuthiwe futhi izifo zingaba zimbi.

items.headline: Buka ingane
items.body: Indlela ingane ebukeka ngayo neyenza ngayo ibaluleke ngaphezu kwenombolo ekwi-thermometer. Ingane ekhanyayo enomkhuhlane ophezulu ayikhathazeki kakhulu kune-floppy enomkhuhlane omncane.

items.headline: Awekho ama-antibiotic
items.body: Ama-antibiotics awawaphathi amagciwane. Imikhuhlane eminingi yezingane iyigciwane - ama-antibiotics ngeke asize futhi angabangela imiphumela engemihle.

pull_quote.text: Ungajahi i-thermometer. Bheka ingane yakho. Ingane esebenzisanayo, ephuzayo, futhi ekhiqiza amanabukeni amanzi yenza kahle - ngisho inomkhuhlane omkhulu. Ingane ephaphathekayo, namehlo ayingilazi idinga usizo - ngisho inomkhuhlane omncane.
pull_quote.source: Isibhedlela Sezingane se-Red Cross War Memorial

signs.heading: Ungasho kanjani ukuthi i-serious
signs.lede: Imfiva ngokwayo ayiyona ingozi. Bheka isithombe sonke - ukuziphatha kwengane yakho, ukuphefumula, uketshezi kanye nanoma yiziphi ezinye izimpawu.

items.title: Mhlawumbe KULUNGILE
items.description: Ingane iyasebenzisana (iyadlala, iyamamatheka, iyabuka), iphuza uketshezi, ikhiqiza amanabukeni amanzi, ayiqubuki, ayiphefumuli kanzima. Umkhuhlane ungaphakama kodwa ingane ifane nayo.

items.title: Bukisisa
items.description: Ingane ithule ngendlela engavamile, ayidlali kakhulu kunokujwayelekile, isuke kancane ekuphakeleni, imfiva ehlala amahora angu-24-48, ukuqubuka okuncane. Hhayi izimo eziphuthumayo kodwa kuwufanele ukuvakashelwa emtholampilo uma kuqhubeka noma kuba kubi kakhulu.

items.title: Thola usizo manje
items.description: I-Floppy noma engaphenduli, ephefumula ngokushesha noma ngokuzikhandla, ukuqubuka okungabuni ngaphansi kwengilazi, intamo eqinile, ukwenqaba konke uketshezi, ukungachami amahora angu-8+, ukuquleka, nanoma iyiphi ingane engaphansi kwezinyanga ezi-3 enomkhuhlane.

items.title: Gqoka kancane — gcina igumbi likhululekile
items.description: Izingubo ezilula, ingubo yokulala uma uqhaqhazela. Unganqwabelani ngezingubo zokulala ezisindayo noma uzisonge - lokhu kunyusa izinga lokushisa lomzimba ngokuqhubekayo.

items.title: Nikeza uketshezi njalo
items.description: Ubisi lwebele, ifomula, amanzi, i-ORS. Amanani amancane, ngokuvamile. Buka amanabukeni amanzi - uphawu lokungena kahle kwamanzi.

items.title: I-Paracetamol noma ibuprofen kuphela ukuze uthole induduzo
items.description: Hhayi ngenxa yenombolo eku-thermometer - kuphela uma ingane ibonakala ingakhululekile. Landela umthamo osuselwe esisindweni ebhodleleni. Ungahlanganisi i-paracetamol ne-ibuprofen ngaphandle kweseluleko sezokwelapha.

items.title: Ungafaki isipontshi ngamanzi abandayo noma ngotshwala
items.description: Lokhu akukhululekile futhi kungabangela ukuqhaqhazela, okuphakamisa izinga lokushisa. Amanzi afudumele alungile uma ingane iwafuna.

items.title: Themba umzwelo wakho
items.description: Uma kukhona okungahambi kahle - ngisho noma ungakwazi ukusho ukuthini - hamba uye emtholampilo. Abazali baqaphela izinguquko ezicashile ezibalulekile. Abasebenzi bezempilo bancamela ukuthi ulethe ingane mahhala kunokuphuthelwa okuthile.

get_help.heading: Lapho okumele uye khona
get_help.lede: Imfiva eminingi yezingane ingalawuleka ekhaya. Ukwazi ukuthi kufanele kunyuke nini ikhono elibalulekile - futhi imitholampilo iyakujabulela ukubona abazali abakhathazekile.
